title: Migrate to CCTP V2 Before CCTP V1 (Legacy) Deprecation | Circle
summary: Learn Circle’s CCTP V1 (Legacy) deprecation timeline and how to migrate to CCTP V2 before deprecation begins on October 31 and completes December 1, 2026.
body_markdown:
‍


Circle plans to begin deprecation of[CCTP V1 (Legacy)](https://developers.circle.com/cctp/v1) on October 31, 2026 and will complete on December 1, 2026, in favor of[CCTP V2](https://developers.circle.com/cctp) (now simply known as CCTP). We[announced this transition](https://www.circle.com/blog/cctp-version-updates) on November 14, 2025, giving the ecosystem nearly a year of notice to migrate to CCTP V2. If your application still routes USDC through CCTP V1 contracts, start your migration now. Migration from CCTP V1 (Legacy) to CCTP V2 is required, not just recommended.


CCTP V2 is infrastructure for multichain digital asset management that enables developers, issuers, and blockchain ecosystems to natively transfer[USDC](https://www.circle.com/usdc) crosschain. New integrations should be built on CCTP V2 from the start.


CCTP V2's functionalities deliver a host of benefits over CCTP V1 (Legacy), including:


- Standard and Fast Transfer modes
- Programmable hooks for triggering automated actions on the destination blockchain after USDC arrives, and
- 27[supported blockchains](https://developers.circle.com/cctp/concepts/supported-chains-and-domains)


‍


## The path to migrate


CCTP V1 (Legacy) burn limits will be reduced starting October 31, 2026, and performance will gradually decrease over a one month window to support a smooth transition to zero usage. After that time, CCTP V1 (Legacy) contracts will be paused on December 1, 2026, and any integration still pointing at them will stop[transferring USDC crosschain](https://bridge.usdc.com/) .


Note: If a developer seeks to use "[replaceDepositForBurn](https://developers.circle.com/cctp/v1/evm-smart-contracts#replacedepositforburn) " to change the mint recipient or destination caller, they must do so prior to January 12, 2026 when this functionality will no longer be supported on CCTP V1.


To begin your migration, start with the[CCTP Migration Guide](https://developers.circle.com/cctp/migration-from-v1-to-v2) . CCTP V2 uses separate contracts and APIs and is not backward compatible with CCTP V1 (Legacy).


The transition from CCTP V1 (Legacy) to CCTP V2 is designed to be transparent, predictable and minimally disruptive. We’re committed to supporting a clean CCTP V1 (Legacy) deprecation, so reach out to our team on[Discord](https://discord.com/invite/buildoncircle) if you hit something unexpected.


‍
